prompt: When did CBERS begin, and when did its first satellite go up?
explanation: The INPE–CAST agreement was signed in 1988, and CBERS-1 was launched on 14 October 1999.

prompt: Why did Brazil and China create CBERS?

options.text: To have their own satellite images instead of relying on other countries
To send astronauts to the Moon
To build a launch base in Maranhão

explanation: Without their own satellites, both countries depended on other nations’ images; CBERS was the answer.
